'''Lieutenant General''' was a grade of [[General/Legends|general]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Lieutenant General|Lieutenant General]] is a relatively standard rank. It is used in almost all modern armies and also in air forces that use army-style ranks, such as the [[Wikipedia:United States Air Force|USAF]]. It is normally placed between [[Major General]] and full [[General/Legends|General]], although in some armies, it has been the highest general rank in use.

In Star Wars [[canon]], however, use of the term is very rare. It only appears as one of the selection of military ranks that are assigned to randomly-generated non-player characters in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'': both Rebel and Imperial templates are known, but it is not clear whether Imperial officers of this rank have appeared in the finished game.

Also, although resources such as the [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]] usually include Lieutenant General in tabulations of ranks and insignia ([http://theforce.net/swtc/order.html#ranks here] and [http://theforce.net/swtc/insignia/badges.html#ltgeneral here]), these claims are, strictly speaking, [[fanon]], and must be treated accordingly on Wookieepedia. No canon evidence exists to show how the position of lieutenant general functions within or in parallel to the canonical rank hierarchies.
